Position Overview:
Prestige Traffic Management Pty Ltd is a leading traffic management and traffic control provider delivering comprehensive traffic management planning, traffic control services, permit applications and road safety solutions across New South Wales and throughout mainland Australia. The company is committed to providing exceptional customer service, maintaining the highest safety standards and supporting civil construction and infrastructure projects with reliable, compliant traffic management services.

As an Office Manager at Prestige Traffic Management Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for overseeing daily administrative operations, supporting project coordination, and ensuring efficient office processes that contribute to the successful delivery of traffic management services. This position requires excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.

•	Coordinate office resources, schedules and documentation to support the delivery of traffic control services, traffic management plans and client projects.
•	Liaise with clients, contractors, suppliers and government authorities regarding bookings, permits, service schedules and project administration.
•	Maintain accurate business records, operational documentation, contracts, invoices and compliance records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
•	Monitor office budgets, purchasing, stock levels and procurement of office and operational supplies to support business activities.
•	Develop, review and improve administrative procedures to enhance operational efficiency and customer service outcomes.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, onboarding documentation and general administrative support for operational teams and management.
•	Support project managers by tracking project progress, preparing reports, coordinating meetings and ensuring timely communication between office staff, field personnel and clients.
•	Assist with the administration of traffic management documentation, council applications, road occupancy licences and other regulatory submissions required for project delivery.
•	Promote a positive workplace culture by maintaining effective communication, supporting continuous improvement initiatives and ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety policies.

Position: Retail Buyer

Location: Block X Brisbane Markets, 385 Sherwood Road, Rocklea QLD 4116

Employment Type: Full-Time 38 Hours per week

Salary: $116,000



About Big Michaels Fruit & Vegetables

Big Michael's Fruit & Vegetables is a Wholesale provider to Retail stores, Restaurants, Cafe's, Clubs etc.



Key Responsibilities

The Retail Buyer will be responsible for selecting, purchasing and coordinating the supply of fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce for the business’s retail, wholesale, hospitality and export customers.

Monitor sales data, customer orders, stock levels and product movement to identify purchasing requirements.

Study fresh produce market conditions, seasonal availability, supplier information, pricing trends and supply shortages.

Select and purchase fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce from farmers, growers, wholesalers and market suppliers.

Inspect, compare and assess produce before purchase, including freshness, quality, grading, size, shelf life and suitability for resale or export.

Negotiate purchase prices, quantities, delivery schedules, payment terms, promotional arrangements and supply conditions with suppliers.

Compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability, delivery capacity, freight costs, seasonal availability and consistency of supply.

Prepare buying plans based on customer demand, retail and wholesale orders, budget requirements, seasonal supply and export needs.

Anticipate consumer demand and determine the quantity, quality and variety of produce to be purchased.

Liaise with management regarding long-term purchasing plans, pricing strategies, product promotions and seasonal sales campaigns.

Recommend retail, wholesale and export pricing based on purchase costs, freight costs, market demand, wastage risk and profit margins.

Coordinate product range, promotional stock allocation and merchandising/display strategies with retail and operations staff.

Maintain strong supplier relationships with farmers, growers, wholesalers, market suppliers and transport providers.

Source produce suitable for hospitality customers and export supply, including produce with appropriate freshness, quality, shelf life and transport timing.

Respond to supply disruptions, price increases or poor seasonal availability by identifying alternative suppliers or substitute products.

Work with internal staff to ensure purchased produce is properly received, recorded, quality checked, stored and allocated.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier terms, price comparisons, delivery commitments and stock planning information.

Prepare supplier comparison reports, seasonal market updates, purchasing recommendations and stock movement reports.

Travel as required to farms, wholesale markets, supplier premises and regional distribution areas to inspect produce and assess market conditions.



Qualifications and Experience

AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV

At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal training

Relevant qualification in business, retail, supply chain, purchasing, agriculture, fresh produce, food distribution or a related field; and/or

Relevant practical experience in retail buying, fresh produce buying, wholesale purchasing or supply chain purchasing. Minimum 12 months of recent work experience.



Skills and Competencies.

Strong knowledge of fresh produce, seasonality, quality standards and pricing fluctuations.

Strong negotiation skills with farmers, growers, wholesalers and suppliers.

Ability to analyse sales data, customer demand, stock levels and product movement.

Ability to compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability and delivery capacity.

Understanding of pricing margins, freight costs, promotional planning and wastage risk.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Strong planning, reporting, research and organizational skills.

Ability to travel regularly across metropolitan and regional locations.

Ability to make commercially sound purchasing decisions.

ABOUT THE COMPANY
Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects
• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications

We have offices around the world, operating in Sydney since 1998; other main offices are located in Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Amsterdam, London, Chicago and Brazil. AAC is ambitious and customer oriented, striving to provide the best integrated service package for the professional business. AAC is a reliable partner, with efficient operations, compliant to all regulations and with a sound risk framework. 

The Software Engineer role contributes to AAC’s mission to optimize performance, risk management, and operational excellence by designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software systems. The position ensures that applications are scalable, reliable, and compliant with financial regulations across APAC. 

The Software Engineer will report to the RAMS APAC Product Owner and be responsible for end-to-end design, development, migration, and optimization of critical clearing applications. This includes: 
• Designing system architecture for applications across Linux, Windows, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and DB2 environments. 
• Leading upgrades and migrations of legacy applications to modern frameworks (Java, Angular, Python, Perl). 
• Ensuring integration, scalability, performance, and maintainability across APAC platforms. 

Key Responsibilities:
1. Software System Design & Architecture 
o Design and implement robust, scalable software architectures for LCM applications. 
o Evaluate and select frameworks, tools, and technologies to optimize system performance. 
o Define database structures and interactions to support enterprise systems. 
2. Development & Engineering 
o Develop, test, and maintain software solutions in Java, Python, Perl, and Angular, aligned with architectural design. 
o Apply engineering best practices (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS) to ensure maintainable and high-quality code. 
3. Application Lifecycle Management 
o Own the full software lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. 
o Lead migration projects, upgrading legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining system integrity. 
4. Technical Leadership & Advisory 
o Provide guidance to Product Owners and the RAMS team on system design, technical decisions, and software strategy.
